sanitization: Manually authored synthetic chapter summaries. No repository content, names, paths, URLs, credentials, or personal data.

cases.title: One interface, two supported versions
cases.summary: An application supports either of two library versions. A compatibility adapter selects the installed version and exposes one stable interface to the rest of the application. This does not imply that both versions run together.
cases.visualBrief: Show a selector choosing one of two differently shaped connectors, then an adapter and a single consistent output interface. Make the inactive connector visually muted.
failureModes: Both versions depicted as simultaneously active

cases.title: Validate before processing
cases.summary: A request is checked before it is processed. A valid request proceeds to processing and a response. An invalid request stops at validation and returns an error without entering processing.
cases.visualBrief: Show an incoming document reaching a checkpoint with two distinct outcomes. The accepted route reaches a processing station. The rejected route ends at a stop marker before that station. Distinguish the routes by symbols as well as color.

cases.title: Retry with a stopping condition
cases.summary: An operation can be attempted at most three times. A success stops further attempts immediately. If all three attempts fail, the operation ends in failure rather than retrying forever.
cases.visualBrief: Show three attempt stations in sequence, with a success exit available from each station and a terminal failure exit after the third. Do not draw a loop back to the first station.
requiredElements: Terminal failure after the final attempt
